summary.en: Early Preclassic through Early Classic: Preclassic lowland complexity (Ceibal, Nakbe, El Mirador, Cival, San Bartolo), stopping at Classic onset.

statement.zh: Inomata 等 2013：塞瓦尔约公元前 1000 年起出现仪式建设与相关低地前古典复杂化证据。
statement.en: Inomata et al. 2013: ceremonial construction at Ceibal from ~1000 BCE and related evidence for early lowland Preclassic complexity.

statement.zh: 圣巴托洛晚前古典壁画语境中的早期玛雅文字，见于 Saturno, Stuart & Beltrán 2006 Science。
statement.en: Early Maya writing in Late Preclassic mural contexts at San Bartolo is reported in Saturno, Stuart & Beltrán 2006 Science.

statement.zh: Estrada-Belli：古典期由公元 3 世纪早期雕刻王室纪念碑开启；本条止于早古典开端。
statement.en: Estrada-Belli: the Classic is inaugurated by early carved royal monuments in the 3rd century CE; this entry stops at Early Classic onset.

statement.zh: 前古典低地存在大型纪念性/城市—仪式复合体（纳克贝、埃尔米拉多尔等），通论中描述为前古典峰值。
statement.en: Preclassic lowlands host large monumental / urban–ritual complexes (Nakbe, El Mirador, etc.), described in surveys as Preclassic florescence peaks.

statement.zh: 奥尔梅克—玛雅影响方向仍属争论；早期低地仪式复杂化与海湾奥尔梅克互动的因果方向不作定论。
statement.en: Olmec–Maya influence direction remains debated; causal direction between early lowland ceremonial complexity and Gulf Olmec interaction is not settled here.

claims.disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

statement.en: Estrada-Belli’s title framing “The First Maya Civilization” is author framing, not a global or pan-Mesoamerican primacy verdict.
